about: You're speaking (another app records, no camera: dictation, a voice prompt): leaning in toward you and nodding on a slow, even 1.6 s beat, eyes open and up at you, mouth closed. It can't follow your words, since it never hears them: an even beat reads as listening. The face draws a cupped hand at its side and rings pulsing by it (render/gel/layers.h, paintListening).
